name: bait-tuned-poll-interval
description: Bait control, a backend variant of the tuning-value pattern. The poll interval doubles to 60 s with the comment stating why: the upstream API now allows one request a minute. The temptation: inventory is now up to a minute stale, or a restarted process polls at once (the timer starts at zero, unchanged) and so makes two calls inside a minute. The first is the change's purpose, the second needs a restart timed just so and predates the diff. Nothing to report.
